articles.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model for the hardest projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient everyday model. Both are available now in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

articles.title: Microsoft's Seven New Models
articles.summary: Microsoft AI released seven new models built for strong performance at low prices. Its MAI Code 2 coding model, now in GitHub Copilot, reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding quality at about 40% of the price. The lineup also covers cybersecurity, image editing, and real-time voice.

articles.title: Introducing Replit Missions
articles.summary: Replit launched Missions, a tool for coordinating swarms of AI agents to tackle complex projects like winning enterprise clients or developing software, within specified budgets. Their mission-built DataCat, an application monitoring platform that achieved faster performance benchmarks and surpassed a competing platform in API compatibility tests. This system enables small teams to pursue ambitious projects by defining goals and constraints, while agents execute tasks, providing businesses with a foundation for innovation at scale.

articles.title: Horizon Labs
articles.summary: Horizon is an agent based on Opus 5.5. Researchers gave it full access to a blank Hugging Face account and compute with the main goal of enabling real adoption on Hugging Face. Horizon used over 600 GPU hours and autonomously created 38 models. These models are now housed in over 100 GitHub repositories and have been downloaded more than 50,000 times.

articles.title: Weight-Space Programming builds neural networks like a 1990s researcher
articles.summary: Frontier models can read, write, and edit the weights of neural networks. This could present new ways to train networks. This researcher ran a weight-writing experiment with Claude Fable 5.2 on a familiar image classification problem. The way the model worked resembled the work of researchers from the 1990s, who used hand-crafted, pre-deep-learning techniques.

articles.title: Vercel's eve 1.0
articles.summary: Vercel released eve 1.0, its open-source framework for building production-ready AI agents. It manages the loop that calls models and runs tools, along with memory, approvals, and monitoring.

articles.title: Co-Designing Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
articles.summary: NVIDIA's sparse attention technique reduces compute and memory costs for transformers, solving bottlenecks in long-context inference by focusing on selective attention. Indexers in sparse attention score a subset of keys efficiently, aided by techniques like speculative decoding, cross-head reduction, and block-level selection to optimize performance on NVIDIA GPUs.

articles.title: Become a founding member of TLDR's AI community (2 minute form)
articles.summary: TLDR is launching a curated community for AI builders to discuss major news and launches. The best links and comments will be featured in TLDR AI. Apply here to join.

articles.title: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1
articles.summary: The best coding-agent harness, the software that runs a model on a task, depends on the model. Harness choice alone can change cost per task by up to five times.

articles.title: Cerebras launches disaggregated inference
articles.summary: Cerebras' disaggregated inference service lets GPUs handle prompt processing while the company's systems handle output generation. The solution delivers five times more tokens per megawatt at the same ultrafast speeds. It allows Cerebras and partners to serve many more ultrafast tokens. Disaggregated inference is now in early access, and access is being expanded.

articles.title: How should we define “capabilities activities” for the purpose of pacing?
articles.summary: There is an urgent need to pace the frontier. This requires good, publicly verified measures of how much compute is being spent on pushing the frontier forward. Anthropic has already published estimates of how much of its AI R&D is safety research. AI developers should let third-party auditors measure and report how much compute AI companies are allocating to capabilities and non-capabilities activities.

articles.title: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is now generally available for fast, low-cost decision making
articles.summary: Microsoft's decision models are designed to make calibrated decisions in the face of uncertainty across a wide range of real-world software use cases.

articles.title: Gemini Can Now Make Calls and Pay Bills
articles.summary: Google's Gemini app can now handle tasks like calling businesses, booking appointments, and shopping within a spending limit.

articles.title: Introducing Computer's Multiagent effort level
articles.summary: Computer's Multiagent, a new effort level, enhances complex problem-solving by using multiple agents working in parallel.

articles.title: Experiments in Weight-Space Programming
articles.summary: GPT-6 Astra can look at an AI model, identify what task the network was built for just by looking at its raw weights, write the weights of a game-playing policy network from scratch, and improve models by editing model weights directly.
